exact_proposition: ∀ (slot node : Nat) (scs : List EnumerationState.Suspended), state.values[slot]? = some (.unenumerated (some node) scs) → ∃ value : InternedConstructorTemplates.Value Symbol NativeGuard, lookupNode heap node = some value ∧ InternedProbeProvenance.Available heap value ∧ value.free = []
other_slot_forms: No condition on enumerated, eliminated, or unenumerated none slots.
empty_distinction: A successful some0 observation is a pending Empty Value; none means no pending node.
